messages:
sam: LAN night this Friday 7pm in the mezzanine — who's in? Bringing PS5 + Smash, would love a couple PCs for Smash Ultimate and Melee setups. Also need an ethernet switch and 2x power strips.

alexa: in! I can bring a 5-port switch and a power strip :thumbsup:

mattie: count me in for PC Smash. I have a portable monitor if needed (USB-C)

jay: can someone bring extra joycons? i only have one pair

rhys: I can bring extra controllers + melee adapter. also happy to run a small bracket.

sophie: i'll bring snacks (vegan options). what time should folks arrive for set-up?

sam: sweet — aim for 6:30 for setup, tournament at 8. @mattie can you bring your desktop? need one station for netplay practice

mattie: yep, i'll have my i5 rig + dock. need to know if we have enough cables — anyone got a few spare ethernet cables (cat6)?

alexa: i've got 3 cat6 x 2m cables, will bring them.

ops-bot: Room booking confirmed: Mezzanine A reserved Fri 6:00–11:00.

jay: can we do a poll for games? i'm down for Rocket League too

sam: poll time — Smash / Rocket League / Speedruns. react with :one: :two: :three:

rhys: :one: (Smash)

sophie: :one:

alexa: :two:

mattie: :three: (speedruns hype)

sam: perfect — Smash majority. bracket sign-up thread coming Thursday. see you all!
